verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that connectors handle incremental syncs automatically, which implies cursor or state tracking between syncs. One community user also calls Fivetran's syncing very reliable. No evidence explicitly documents automatic retry of transient failures or resuming an interrupted sync from a checkpoint, and another user reports occasional out-of-sync states that needed full re-syncs. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry behavior for transient errors, documented checkpoint/resume semantics for interrupted syncs, independent hands-on corroboration of resume behavior.
